paper_id: Zheng et al. - 2017 - Detecting radio frequency interference for CSI measurements on COTS WiFi devices
title: Detecting Radio Frequency Interference for CSI Measurements on COTS WiFi Devices
motivation: RFI严重劣化CSI感知性能，但在WiFi感知文献中未获充分关注
problem_framing: 如何从每个CSI测量中检测交叉技术干扰，以识别被污染的CSI
key_insight: RFI信号的循环平稳特性不会从CSI中完全消失
method_signature: SCF梯度矩阵+SVD和CAF纹理分析+GLCM能量
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 蓝牙跳频和微波扫描导致TP率降低；远距离干扰或收发近距离时性能显著下降
evidence_for_taste: does not deal with interfered CSI directly
detect RFI for each CSI measurement
not feasible to simply select a threshold
the existence of cross-technology interference is sufficient for most CSI-based sensing applications
thinking_moves: 从物理层信号属性(循环平稳性)反推其在CSI中的可检测性
将时域/频域分析分别应用于CSI的不同视角(CAF vs SCF)
从信号处理引入图像分析工具(GLCM纹理)来处理CSI序列
承认在特定干扰类型下算法失效的事实(蓝牙/微波)
extraction_notes: 论文未明确标注venue信息，仅从内容推断为会议论文；role标注基于作者署名顺序推测
